instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Custom furniture manufacturer crafting solid wood pieces for hospitality and high-end residential projects. Vault operates at the intersection of traditional, hand-finished joinery and modern CNC routing, positioning itself in a niche where quality is paramount. The company currently prioritizes operational stability while attempting to leverage emerging automation technologies to maintain competitive pricing without compromising bespoke craftsmanship.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.additionalContext: Vault faces intense competition from larger, automated suppliers who can offer faster turnaround times and lower per-unit costs. The company's high customization overhead makes it vulnerable to price wars while simultaneously struggling with the transition to necessary digital tools.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Implement Modular Product Configuration Digital Tool
opportunities.rationale: To address customer pain points regarding complexity and slow lead times, developing a simple digital tool allows customers to visualize their custom product choices before production starts. This incremental step improves the sales process without requiring massive R&D investment.

first_actions: Audit current order entry software capabilities
Prototype a web-based configuration selector for core products
Pilot tool with 10 key enterprise clients
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in average order cycle time reduction by 15% within Q3.
milestones: Month 2: Client feedback integration and iterative refinement

opportunities.title: Invest in Advanced Sustainable/Material Innovation Line
opportunities.rationale: Given the market pressure, pivoting to a novel material (e.g., engineered timber or advanced composites) could create a premium, defensible niche that bypasses direct price competition. This requires radical strategic alignment but offers high long-term differentiation.

first_actions: Conduct small feasibility study on CNC compatibility and finish quality
Secure grant funding or low-interest financing for pilot runs
resources_needed: Consulting fees for material science validation
execution_plan.success_metric: Launch of one 'premium' product line capturing 5% of new revenue within the year.
milestones: Month 6: Material Selection and Feasibility Complete
Month 9: Pilot Production Run and Quality Validation

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated, part-time technical advisory role focused solely on technology evaluation.
Develop a costed roadmap for digital self-service tools and prioritize the 'Modular Configuration Tool' MVP.

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on founder expertise leading to limited technical bandwidth
Fragmented and manual innovation process lacking structured experimentation cycles
Limited digital maturity (Level 2) hindering scalable customer engagement tools
High dependency on legacy systems which complicates new technology integration
